result.summary: Found 1 major content issue on the restaurant listing page: an invalid '-100%' discount badge displayed on one of the restaurant cards.

issues.description: The second restaurant card under the 'Popular right now' section displays an invalid '-100%' discount badge in the top-left corner.
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount calculation logic and data source for promotional badges to ensure valid percentage values are displayed, or hide the badge when the discount value is invalid.
